translations.web: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
translations.bsb: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
translations.kjv: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
translations.asv: and the rib, which Jehovah God had taken from the man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
